description: Run your Home Assistant from your agent through Selora AI's MCP server (137 tools). Control devices, check sensors and history, look at cameras, and build or fix automations, scenes, scripts, helpers and dashboards. Organise areas, floors and labels, diagnose broken integrations and Zigbee/Z-Wave devices, and manage updates, backups, HACS and apps. Use it whenever the user asks about their smart home or Home Assistant. Connects over MCP with Selora Connect OAuth or a scoped Selora MCP token.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
